description:
### test 11 (2026-11-24)

**Features**
- The two phones of a comparison stay level whatever their labels (Play next in queue type moved up and down between options)
- The top bar always comes back at the top of the list (it could stay hidden after Show on Mute button until a small scroll down and up)
- The list stretches half as far past its ends
- Opening a screen from the card menu shows only that screen (the last one's preview frame flashed first)
- With screens not grouped, each menu card is one compact row in Morphe's order
- Comparison labels fit from the first moment of each round (six comparisons stuck out briefly)
- A glide's travelling colour keeps the glass edge of the part it lands on, and the part's own fill takes over in the same frame (no grey fade or label flash at the end)

**Bug Fixes**
- A back swipe that is started and then let go no longer flashes the screen or leaves a see-through menu fading over it
- The regular Morphe list no longer shows for a moment before the visual editor opens
- Only delay with Bluetooth audio pills no longer overlap on small phones

**Performance Improvements**
- Popups open and close 1.5x as fast

### test 10 (2026-11-24)

**Features**
- iOS-like feel in every design: springy presses and glides, popups grow out of the tapped button, lists stretch at their ends, the back swipe follows your finger, light system haptics
- Smoother entry: Morphe settings stay visible while the editor loads, then it rises in as one motion
- Import / Export works like Morphe's own dialog, and values refresh after it
- Settings Morphe edits with its own picker (button order, file and folder pickers) open Morphe's editor instead of a text field
- Search understands the words people type (hyphens, word endings, swipe / pull / slide / drag)
- A search result for a Morphe screen opens that screen's tab
- Morphe design uses the Glass card list
- Comparisons start at once; 104 of them show only the part of the screen they are about, drawn larger
- New and redrawn stories: Post buttons layout, Narrow navigation buttons, pinch-to-zoom, Shorts, feeds, Like and Subscribe glow, Downloads and more
- The redesign needs WebView (Chromium) 138 or newer; older WebViews get the regular Morphe list

**Bug Fixes**
- Importing settings no longer switches the redesign off or brings up Morphe's own restart dialog
- An import no longer overwrites Morphe's internal state (an old player script hash stopped every video)
- Tab and toggle glides end without a pop, and glass pills keep their rim
- Many animation fixes: seekbar thumb, overlapping previews, jumping parts, clipped and shifting stories

**Performance Improvements**
- Tabs and options glide smoothly on the phone even while a new screen is drawn
- Popups grow from the tapped button on the compositor; quicker comparisons and stories

### test 9 (2026-11-24)

**Features**
- The editor is the designed live preview, running inside Morphe settings on a full-screen card menu with predictive back
- Values, titles, list choices, defaults and availability come live from your Morphe build; only settings with a row in your Morphe list are shown
- Morphe's action rows work in the editor (import / export, export logs, links)
- Save for later: changes that need a restart are kept, and the next visit offers Apply and restart, Reset or Continue
- Three UI designs (Original, Morphe, Liquid Glass) with automatic device tiers
- Redesigned group cards, locked settings with an unlock animation, gliding option pills and toggles
- Side-by-side comparisons and animations for most settings, reorganised by where they act
- Renamed Morphe settings keep their preview; new list values show plainly
- Disable new design button in the screen menu; "Redesign unsupported on this device" when the WebView can't run it

**Bug Fixes**
- The patch never makes patching fail; it only logs a warning when Morphe settings are missing
- Changes are no longer undone by Morphe's forced restart when settings close
- A greyed-out setting can't be changed, and a failed read opens the regular Morphe list instead
- Settings without a row (deprecated, internal) stay out of the editor
- Setting titles no longer carry Morphe's invisible new-setting marker
- Many animation fixes: autoplay, loop count, quality priority, toolbar tabs, menus, fullscreen, captions

**Performance Improvements**
- Lighter scrolling and redraws, cheaper glass rendering, faster unlock and glides
